, for multi-way joins, hash joins are more efficient than NLJs.
hash join is the best algorithm, followed by NLJ, followed by the other methods.
, in the case of sliding window multi-joins, the choice of the algorithm to be used depends on the characteristics of the data stream and of the sliding window.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, although the problem of processing sliding window multi-joins is NP-hard in the general case, we can still find a solution that is practical for most real-life scenarios.
we propose an incremental join algorithm for multi-join queries over data streams, which is based on the idea of using a sliding window.

the processing cost of multi-join queries can be minimized by using hash-based join algorithms.
